This API is used to configure autoscaling for a DB instance. You will be billed for the autoscaled storage. If available storage drops to a specified threshold or 10 GB, your storage will auto scale by 15% (in increments of 10 GB) of your allocated storage. Autoscaling up the storage of a read replica does not affect that of the primary instance. New storage space of the read replica after autoscaling must be greater than or equal to that of the primary instance.
